Backpacks with outer surface of textile materials: HTSUS 4202.92. Subheading 4202.92.31 covers "Travel, sports and similar bags: with outer surface of sheeting of plastics or textile materials: Other: Of man-made fibers: Backpacks"? Let me recall the structure.

4202.92: Travel, sports and similar bags: With outer surface of sheeting of plastics or of textile materials:
- 4202.92.04 Insulated food or beverage bags
- Other: 4202.92.08 Beach bags... 
- 4202.92.10 Of vegetable fibers...
- 4202.92.15 Of cotton...
- 4202.92.20 Sports bags: Of man-made fibers...
- 4202.92.31 Other: Of man-made fibers? Actually 4202.92.30 is "Other: Of cotton"? 

I recall 4202.92.9026 "Other: Backpacks: Other" and 4202.92.31 "Travel, sports and similar bags: Other: Of man-made fibers: Other: Backpacks"? In CBP rulings for polyester backpacks: "classified in 4202.92.3131, HTSUS, which provides for 'Travel, sports and similar bags... With outer surface of sheeting of plastic or of textile materials: Other: Of man-made fibers: Other: Backpacks'" Yes, 4202.92.3131 is commonly cited for backpacks of man-made fibers. Common for child's backpacks too.

{"hts_code": "4202.92.3131", "reason": "A backpack with an outer surface of 100% polyester textile material is classified as a travel, sports and similar bag of man-made fibers, backpack, under heading 4202, subheading 4202.92.31."}
